Subject: Orchid Health — marketplace onboarding eligibility + pay-rail questionnaire

Hi Sanjay — great to meet today (quick recap below). Per Maya's note, I'm sending a short checklist and a few clarifying questions so your procurement team can evaluate the right commercial path (card, PO, or AWS Marketplace). Would love to lock a 30-min follow-up with your procurement/finance folks once you have the answers.

Recap from today's call:
- Primary use case: running patient-risk scoring batch jobs + low-latency API for clinician UI.
- Expected steady-state: 6M tokens/month, burstable for growth.
- Data residency: US-only (HIPAA scope).
- Timeline: pilot in Q4, production early Q1 2028.

Key procurement/marketplace questions (please send to procurement or paste replies inline):
1) Payment preference: card on file, PO net-30, or must go via AWS Marketplace (SaaS contract + consolidated billing)?
2) If PO: do you require a signed vendor W-9 and a pre-filled purchase order template? Any minimum PO approval thresholds?
3) If Marketplace: do you need a Private Offer (SaaS contract + negotiated terms) or will standard Marketplace listing suffice?
4) Contract redlines: which clause owners are required to review (legal, security, privacy)? Estimated review SLA?
5) Procurement docs needed: (a) SOW/Order Form, (b) Vendor security questionnaire, (c) SOC 2 report link — I attached a checklist and standard order form for quick review.

Attachments: orchid-procurement-checklist-2027.xlsx, redwood-enterprise-order-form-v1.pdf

Next steps:
- Sanjay: confirm payment route + who on procurement we should loop in (name + email).
- Jonas/Marissa: schedule 30-min procurement sync the week of Aug 16 if interested.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Agarwal <sanjay@orchidhealth.com>

Thanks Jonas — quick answers inline.

On Tue, Aug 10, 2027 at 1:02 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Key procurement/marketplace questions (please send to procurement or paste replies inline):

1) Payment preference: PO net-30 is our default for anything > $10k/month. For pilot we can do card, but production needs PO.

2) If PO: yes, we require vendor W-9 and a completed company vendor form (I attached a blank). PO approvals are routed by Finance; anything > $50k requires VP Finance sign-off.

3) If Marketplace: we prefer AWS Marketplace Private Offer only if it doesn't add a 60+ day procurement delay. If Redwood can do a Private Offer with standard terms and expedite, that's attractive.

4) Contract redlines: Legal will review SOW and data/privacy clauses (HIPAA). Security team reviews the questionnaire. Expect ~2–3 week review for standard redlines.

5) Procurement docs: send SOC 2 link and vendor questionnaire; I'll share to Finance and Procurement.

Maya and I can join a procurement sync. Looping in our procurement lead in the next email once I have her availability.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Agarwal

A) Can you confirm the name and email for the procurement contact (Finance AP) so we can share the vendor packet and W-9?

B) If Private Offer is acceptable, would Orchid accept Redwood's standard Marketplace Private Offer SLA (30-day invoice terms) or do you need net-30 on Private Offers as well? We can scope both options in paperwork but want to avoid back-and-forth on signature routing.

I've uploaded the SOC 2 report link and a filled example order form to our internal shared Drive (link below) — Marissa will run the Marketplace ops checklist and draft a Private Offer if you confirm procurement contact.
